meta.source_title: The Archimede Rover: A Comparison between Simulations and Experiments (Caruso, Giberna, Gorner, Gallina, Seriani; Robotics 12(5), 125, 2023)
meta.vehicle: Archimede rover prototype, four independently steered and driven wheels, wheelbase 0.720 m, track 0.443 m, body 1.61 kg plus two legs of 1.58 kg (Table 1); commanded mean wheel speed 2.4 rad/s
meta.soil: granular lava, grain size 1 to 5 mm (Test Setup A)
meta.x_name: slope angle of the tilted sandbox (nominal, 5 deg steps)
meta.y_name: slip s (median of all drive tests at that slope and wheel speed)
meta.comparability_note: Panel (a), Test Setup A. Orange open triangles = omega 2 (2.4 rad/s). Assumed the plotting software centres the triangle marker on its bounding box (MATLAB style); if the data point were the area centroid instead, every slip value would be about 0.008 lower. The 20 deg triangle touches the right frame but is complete. Five points.
